## Checklist
- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate.py` passes (no ERROR); warnings are fixed or explained below
- [ ] Every new claim has a public source; my own inferences are marked *Inference:*
- [ ] Nothing existing was deleted or overwritten without a Revisions or Perspectives note
- [ ] No DMs or private chats (without consent), wallet addresses, keys or seed phrases, real names of pseudonymous people, unverified allegations, or shilling
- [ ] The Automat paper is cited at most once per entry, in Sources
- [ ] No markdown tables in entries; header lines contain no [[wikilinks]]
